words.headline: Friday Gets Loud Outside: Street Party Noise Jumps to 411 Calls
words.blurb: Loud music on the street hit 411 complaints Friday, well above the usual 283, as a 70-degree day pulled the party outdoors. Meanwhile no-heat calls cooled off to 905, down from a typical 1,439.
words.card_line: Radiators rested, the block party didn't

boroughs.Bronx: Home repairs led with 663 calls, edging out parking and noise.
boroughs.Brooklyn: Parking wars ruled with 1,152 calls, nearly double its noise tally.
boroughs.Manhattan: Noise topped the list at 635, because of course it did.
boroughs.Queens: Parking wars dominated at 866 calls, twice the noise count.
boroughs.Staten Island: Parking led with 89 calls, a quiet day by any standard.
